basis: Defining brain, limb and renal malformations; strabismus in 7/18. Hypertrichosis is non-damaging; constipation alone does not establish gut damage.
Broad terminal thumb and great-toe phalanges establish skeletal involvement; supplied record does not establish intellectual disability or other organ damage.
Congenital skeletal muscle myopathy with characteristic biopsy abnormalities; reduced reflexes do not establish separate nerve disease.
Progressive skeletal muscle dystrophy; cardiac and respiratory abnormalities occur in only 1-4%. The broader PLEC spectrum does not establish skin disease here.
Thyroid hormone deficiency following surgery defines an endocrine disorder.
Isolated impaired parathyroid hormone secretion causes an endocrine and calcium-regulation disorder; other organ damage is not established.
Pulmonic stenosis 3/10; scoliosis and intellectual disability 5/5; strabismus 3/5. Esophageal anomalies 2/5 omitted by cap; melanoma is a separate disease.
Umbrella disorder of the conjunctiva; infection or immune disease is not shared by all major subtypes.
Blind eye with elevated intraocular pressure; ocular hypertension does not establish systemic cardiovascular disease.
Congenital communication between the aorta and pulmonary artery; both are cardiovascular structures.
Acute myeloid leukemia with marrow fibrosis and pancytopenia; weakness and back pain do not establish skeletal muscle or bone damage.
Viral respiratory tract infection; conjunctival inflammation and myalgia are transient, while myocardial and CNS complications are uncommon.
Developmental brain malformations define the disease; microphthalmia and retinal dysplasia occur in 1/3 reported patients.
Definition includes neurodevelopmental impairment, seizures and visual/ocular abnormalities; altered intracellular lipid signaling alone adds no metabolic axis.
Odontogenic epithelial tumor arising within the jaw, involving dental tissues and jaw bone.
Motor-neuron degeneration with denervation muscle atrophy in 3/3. Respiratory insufficiency in 4/11 reflects respiratory muscle failure, not intrinsic lung disease.
Congenital atrioventricular conduction disease; the umbrella includes immune and nonimmune causes, so an immune mechanism is not universal.
Lectin complement pathway deficiency; recurrent infections do not establish common lasting damage to a particular additional organ.
Congenital uterine malformation affects a reproductive organ outside the 13 axes.
Destructive developmental brain disorder with cortical loss and severe neurologic impairment; skull/scalp changes do not establish separate functional damage.
Neuroblastic tumor of sympathetic neural tissue; no specific adrenal origin or common extra-neural organ damage is established.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in and confined to the lung at diagnosis; lymphoma also requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis.
Structural abnormality of the diaphragm, a skeletal muscle; elevation alone does not establish intrinsic lung damage.
Immune-mediated inflammation damages the optic nerve, assigned to ocular; extra-optic neurologic disease is not shared across this umbrella.
Defined by visceral diverticula, marfanoid skeletal/connective-tissue abnormalities with hernias, and retinal detachment; aortic disease is not established.
